build_dictionary: build a vocabulary dictionary from a list of text files with configurable threshold and padding factor
load_dictionary: load a pre-existing vocabulary dictionary from a file using the FairseqTask class method
build_model: build a FairseqModel instance from configuration and apply optional scalar quantization
build_generator: build a SequenceGenerator with configurable beam search, sampling, or diverse beam strategies
train_step: perform a forward and backward pass returning loss, sample size, and logging output
